title: A bill to designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 4910 Brighton Boulevard in Denver, Colorado, as the "George Sakato Post Office".
official_summary: (Sec. 1) Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 4910 Brighton Boulevard in Denver, Colorado, as the "George Sakato Post Office."

summary.headline: Congress named a Denver post office after George Sakato, a Colorado figure.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 4910 Brighton Boulevard in Denver, Colorado, as the "George Sakato Post Office." It is an honorary designation and does not change how the post office operates. Mail service, staffing, and hours stay the same.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on July 27, 2018.
